text: Long catch-up with Blessing over coffee. Her puppy Biscuit is finally toilet trained, mostly. She's running the Bristol 10k on 12 October and is weirdly calm about it. Her sister Ines is coming down to watch.
Andile called. His band has a gig at the Lexington on 3rd of November, first proper headline slot. He's really nervous about it, hasn't slept much. Text him good luck that morning.

Lindiwe's cat Pepper has been off her food all week and they're taking her to the vet Thursday. Lindiwe sounded wrecked. Her partner Dev is away in Lisbon till the 18th so she's on her own with it. Should ring her the day after the vet.
Quick one: Oisín's play opens 21/11 at the community theatre, he's playing the dad. His mum's flying over from Galway for it. Matteo and I are going on the Saturday.

Caught up with Eli and Chloe at the park. They're getting a second dog, a rescue greyhound called Rocket, collecting him on the 9th. Chloe's started a new job at the vets on Gloucester Road, which is handy. Eli still obsessed with fell running.
Irina's daughter has her grade 5 piano recital on 14 May. Irina says she's practising four hours a day and in tears half the time. Don't forget to send Irina a message afterwards to see how it went.
Gabriel is doing the London Marathon again in April, his third. He's raising money for the hospice that looked after his dad. Must sponsor him before payday runs out.
Ciara's birthday is 2nd of March. She was going on about wanting a proper record player, the old one's knackered. Damian said he'd chip in.
Damian's five-a-side team won the league final last night, he's insufferable. His knee's strapped up though, says it's a sprain. Physio on Monday.

Simone and Zoe's wedding has been called off. Simone moved out last weekend and is staying with her brother Ryan in Leeds. Zoe's keeping the flat and the cat. Need to check in on Simone next week, gently.
Saskia FaceTimed from Melbourne. She's flying home 19 December and wants a big dinner the day after she lands. Erin's offered to host. I'm doing desserts.
Erin's dog Moss turns ten on the 30th and she's actually throwing him a party, cake and everything. Apparently he likes peanut butter biscuits. Pick some up on the way.

Rin said her dad's having his hip done on 4th December and she'll be staying with her parents for a fortnight afterwards. She's worried about him managing the stairs. Remind me to call Rin the day after the op.

Bumped into Yetunde at Tesco. She's doing her first triathlon in Weymouth on 7 June, training like mad. Her husband Marcus is doing it too but only the relay bit. She swims, he cycles, someone from work runs.
Marcus mentioned he's leaving his job at the council end of the month to go freelance. Bit nervous about money but excited. His leaving drinks are 28/11 at the Crown. I'm going.
Mustafa and Sadia's parrot Kiwi escaped on Sunday and came back the next morning on its own, sitting on the shed roof. They're thinking of getting it microchipped now. Funny story, tell Jaya.
Called Dafydd. He's singing in the male voice choir's Christmas concert at St David's Hall on 15 December. Carmen and I should get tickets before they sell out. He's a bass, apparently.

Carmen's been struggling since her mum passed in August. She's not sleeping and has taken a couple of weeks off work. She likes gardening, maybe some bulbs. Should drop round with something at the weekend.
Jaya's son Yaw got into the county under-14 cricket squad. First match is 2nd of May at Taunton. Jaya's over the moon, Yaw is pretending not to care. Send Yaw a card to say well done.

Beatriz is moving to Porto on 1 February for her partner's job. Leaving do the Saturday before. She's taking both cats, which sounds like a nightmare on a plane. Her boyfriend Mateus is Portuguese, family's there.

Zeynep has a violin audition for the conservatoire on 11/03 and she's terrified. Her teacher thinks she's ready. She wants a run-through in front of people the week before, so I said I'd come and listen.
Farah's new kitten is called Pickle and has already destroyed two curtains. Vet for jabs next Tuesday. She sent about forty photos.

Long chat with Blessing and Andile at the pub. Andile's gig on the 3rd got moved to the 10th because the venue flooded. Blessing's running club does a parkrun on the morning of her birthday, 22 November, then breakfast at hers. She asked me to bring the good coffee. Andile's planning to come after his soundcheck. Need to get her something, she mentioned a foam roller.
Ines's grandad turns 90 on 6th of January. The whole family's going to Lisbon for a long weekend, flying out the day before. She's anxious about him travelling to the restaurant.
Spoke to Eli about Chloe's half marathon on Sunday. She's got a dodgy hamstring and might pull out. Message her that evening either way.

Dev's back from Lisbon. Says Lindiwe's cat had to have a tooth out but is eating again. They're going to the Arctic Monkeys gig at the Etihad on 24 June. Dev wants to borrow my camping chairs for a festival in July.
Gabriel's little girl had her nativity yesterday, she was a sheep. He filmed the whole thing. Ask him to send me the video.
Matteo's football team play the cup semi on 8 March. If they win, the final is a week after, 15th. He reckons they've got no chance. Go along to the semi with Oisín.
Note to self: renew passport before 3rd of April. Dentist moved to 14/01. Book car in for MOT.
Ciara Brennan from work is doing a charity swim across Lake Windermere on 20 July. Training every morning before work at the lido. Her husband thinks she's mad. Sponsor her, £20.

Coffee with Damian. His mum's been in and out of hospital with her chest, had more tests on Friday. Results due the week after. He's holding up but tired. His girlfriend Saskia's been brilliant. Text him once he hears back.

Simone's doing stand-up for the first time, open mic at the Comedy Box on 17/10. She's petrified. Zoe and Ryan are coming, and I've promised to sit at the back and laugh loudly. Ask her afterwards if she'd do another.
Zoe adopted an elderly terrier called Gus from the rescue. He's thirteen and has a heart murmur, needs tablets twice a day. She says he snores like a train.
Erin's band are playing a wedding in Cornwall on 5th of September, then driving straight to a festival the next day. She's knackered just thinking about it. Erin plays bass, her brother Ryan drums.
Ryan Williams called about the boat race fundraiser. He's rowing for the alumni crew on 29 March and wants a few of us at the riverbank. Afterwards drinks at the boathouse. I'll organise the lift.
Rin's cat Mochi was put to sleep on Saturday. She had him seventeen years. Send flowers, and maybe call her midweek.

Yetunde mentioned Marcus's mum is visiting from Accra for three weeks from 2nd of December. They're doing a big Christmas for the first time. Marcus is stressing about the spare room. His mum loves jollof, obviously, and hates the cold.

Mustafa got through to the final of the regional chess tournament on 18/05. He's playing someone he's lost to twice. Sadia says he's been studying openings every night. Must text him good luck the night before.
Sadia's pregnant, due 14th of April. Mustafa told me while she was in the loo, she's having awful morning sickness. They're not finding out the sex.

Dafydd's dog Bryn has been limping and the vet thinks it's a torn ligament. Surgery on 9 January, then six weeks of crate rest. Dafydd's gutted, Bryn is a terror when he's bored. Offer to walk him a week after the op when he's allowed out.
Carmen's daughter Lucía starts uni in Edinburgh at the end of September. Carmen's driving her up the day before freshers. She's going to be a mess. Check in with Carmen the week after.
Jaya and Yaw are off to watch the Ashes at Lord's on 18 June, a birthday treat for Yaw. Jaya got the tickets months ago. Yaw turns 14 that week.
Yaw messaged to say thanks for the card. Apparently he took four wickets in his first county game.

Beatriz's leaving do has been cancelled because the flights got moved forward, she now goes on 20 January. Instead she's having a few people round to the flat the night before. Bring wine and help her pack.
Zeynep got into the conservatoire! Starts in September. Her parents are throwing a little party on 2nd of June. Should get her a nice music stand or something.
Farah's brother Andile is getting married in Durban on 12 August. She's been asked to do a reading and is already panicking. Her mum's sorting the outfits.

Had a long call with Lindiwe tonight. Pepper's on new kidney meds and seems better. Lindiwe's own exams for her accountancy course are 4th and 5th of December, she's barely revised because of the cat drama. Dev's off to his brother's stag in Prague on the 6th, the day after her last exam, which she's not thrilled about. I said I'd take her out for dinner once it's all done. Remind me to text her good luck the morning of the first one.

Oisín's Dad, Mr Brennan, is retiring from the fire service on 31 March after thirty-five years. There's a do at the station the following Friday. Oisín wants us to sign a card. Need to get it to him by the 25th.

Ines and Gabriel came round for dinner. Gabriel's knee is shot after the marathon training, physio says rest. Ines has taken up bouldering instead and is weirdly good at it. They're off to Japan for three weeks in October, flying out the 4th. Ines wants restaurant tips for Osaka.
Chloe called in tears. Rocket got out of the garden this morning and was missing for six hours before a neighbour found him. He's fine, just muddy. She's getting the fence fixed tomorrow.
Irina's thinking about getting a dog but her landlord won't allow it. She's looking at flats in Bishopston instead. Prefers somewhere with a garden.
Matteo Santos told me his grandmother in Naples had a fall. He's flying out on Wednesday and staying a week, maybe longer. He'll miss the semi. Need to ring him once he's back.
Eli said he's entered the Three Peaks challenge in late June with his brother Marcus. They've not trained at all. Their mum is furious.
Grabbed lunch with Saskia Osei. She's started dog-sitting for extra cash, has three regulars including a giant Newfoundland called Bear. Wants to do it full time eventually.
Andile's gig on 10 November was amazing, the place was rammed. He was buzzing the next day. Send him the photos I took.
Got tickets for the Royal Ballet on 14 February for me and Carmen. Need to book a table somewhere nearby for afterwards.
Dr Zhou said Farah's rabbit needs his teeth filed every couple of months. Farah's fine with it but her kids get upset. Their youngest, Amira, has a swimming gala on the 23rd and wants Auntie to come.
Beatriz texted from Porto. Settled in, cats survived the flight, and she's found a choir. First concert 3rd of May. Must visit in the spring, maybe the week after Easter.
Mustafa won the chess final! Sadia sent a video of him holding the trophy looking stunned. He's on the local radio on Thursday morning talking about it.

Simone's doing much better. She's got a new place in Headingley near Ryan and has signed up for a pottery course starting 6 January. Zoe dropped her old jumper back, which was decent of her. I should go up and see Simone in the new year, maybe the weekend of 24th of January.
